front.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Little Mung base character FRONT image for a four-view 3D modeling reference set.
Input image 1 is the exact character identity reference. Preserve its very cute stylized 3D toy face: broad softly squared round cheeks, large brown eyes and white sclera, tiny catchlights, delicate eyelashes and eyebrows, tiny rounded nose, tiny gently curved CLOSED mouth, warm peach skin, ears, oversized head, very short compact body and limbs. Do not redesign the character or turn it into a realistic person.
Change only the requested preparation: completely REMOVE scalp hair, bangs and side hair, leaving a smooth natural bald scalp following the original head volume (not a taller elongated skull); retain eyebrows and eyelashes. Replace jacket, top, shorts and shoes with a simple close-fitting light neutral gray short-sleeved crewneck T-shirt and matching mid-thigh shorts, both exactly the same solid color, no cuffs, no pockets, no decoration, no logos. Bare stylized feet, no accessories. The character remains fully and modestly clothed.
Pose: neutral symmetrical rigging A-pose, standing upright, both straight arms angled approximately 40 degrees away from the sides of the torso, hands relaxed open and visibly separate from the thighs, elbows not bent, fingers clearly readable, legs straight and slightly apart, feet parallel flat on the ground. Face looks straight at camera, head level, mouth closed with a very subtle friendly neutral curve.
Camera: STRICT FRONT orthographic-like straight-on view, no three-quarter rotation, no tilted or elevated camera, no perspective foreshortening. Full head to soles, centered in a SQUARE image, top of scalp at about 6% image height and soles at 94%, no cropping. Keep original very oversized head to body ratio; do not make body taller or head smaller.
Background plain pure white. Soft even neutral studio light, minimal contact shadow, matte softly rendered 3D toy materials matching the supplied image, clear readable silhouette. Single character, single view only. No text, labels, borders, grids, diagrams, props or watermark. This is the master front view: all later side and back references will use this exact design.
